android.title:
Less typing.
More you.
android.intro: Speak naturally. OpenWhispr turns your thoughts into clear text, wherever you write.
android.privateBody: Run speech and text models on this phone. Cloud processing and cloud sync are separate choices, always in your control.
android.setupBody: Choose your language. Start privately on this phone, or choose cloud or your own provider in Models.
android.bubbleHold: OpenWhispr: tap or hold to talk
android.cancelOrClose: Cancel dictation or close the bubble
android.recoverDictation: Open OpenWhispr to recover your dictation
android.selectToEdit: Select some text before using Edit.
android.practiceBody: Tap the message field, then tap or hold the floating OpenWhispr bubble. Release to finish; tap the bubble again to stop hands-free recording.
android.dictateExample: “I will be there in ten minutes. Can you bring the coffee?”
android.translateExample: Say “I will be there in ten minutes.” We’ll translate it into your chosen language.
android.editExample: Start with “Apples, bread and milk.” Then say “Change milk to oat milk.”
android.writeExample: Ask for a short message, such as “Write a friendly thank-you for the coffee.”
android.success: That worked. Your words are ready.
android.sampleHint: Import prerecorded audio to test the same pipeline without using the microphone.
android.noSpeech: We couldn’t hear any speech. Try again when you’re ready.
android.modelIntro: Speech turns audio into text. A separate text model cleans up, translates and edits. Downloads stay on this device.
android.downloadNeeded: Download a speech model and a text model before your first local dictation.
android.speechDownloadNeeded: Download the speech model in Models before recording.
android.textDownloadNeeded: Download a text model in Models for local cleanup, translation and editing.
android.acrossTitle:
A little bubble.
A lot less typing.
android.acrossBody: Use your usual keyboard in Messages, Gmail, Slack and more. Focus a text field, then activate OpenWhispr.
android.overlayBody: Keeps your dictation button within reach.
android.insertionBody: Accessibility lets OpenWhispr read the focused field when you dictate and insert your result. It never sends messages or reads password fields.
android.microphoneBody: Requested when you start recording. Nothing is recorded while the bubble is idle.
android.reliabilityBody: Some phones pause background apps. If dictation stops unexpectedly, review battery settings. You can turn the bubble off here at any time.
android.proBody: Keep unlimited on-device dictation free. OpenWhispr Pro adds hosted processing and cloud features for your account.
android.proNote: Prices and offers come directly from Google Play through our secure paywall. A completed purchase may take a moment to appear on your account.
android.readyBody: Messages. Emails. Notes. Wherever your next thought belongs.
android.emptyHistoryBody: Hold the button below, or import an audio file. Your history stays on this phone unless you choose to sync.
android.assistantHint: Ask a question or tell OpenWhispr what to write.
android.cleanupPreference: Polish dictated text using the workflow selected in Models & processing.
android.licenseIntro: OpenWhispr uses these open models and libraries. Attribution is available here even when offline.
android.parakeetCredit: Speech model by NVIDIA. ONNX conversion and int8 quantization by the Sherpa-ONNX project; weights are downloaded without further changes.
android.qwenCredit: Local text cleanup, translation, writing and editing models; official quantized GGUF releases.
android.retentionHint: Applies to dictation history on this phone. Notes are kept separately.
android.syncSignIn: Sign in to enable cloud backup. Your notes currently stay on this phone.
android.syncPolicy: Cloud backup is turned off by your organization.
android.syncPro: Cloud backup requires Pro for your account.
android.syncExplanation: Personal notes sync when backup is on. Shared-space notes follow your workspace’s sync policy.
android.analyticsBody: Share performance and app-session metrics to help improve OpenWhispr. Transcription content is excluded.
android.selectionPrivacyBody: When you start a cross-app dictation, OpenWhispr reads the focused field to preserve existing text and replace your selection. Password fields are excluded. Processing follows your selected workflow: on-device, OpenWhispr Cloud, or your provider.
android.reviewUnavailable: This development app is not listed in the Play Store yet.
android.styleBody: Choose a context and its tone for your next dictation. Each context remembers your choice. Your custom cleanup prompt can add more detail.
android.permissionDenied: Microphone access is off. Enable it in app settings to record, or import an audio file.
android.insertionFailed: Your text is ready in Home. The original field changed or doesn’t support insertion.
android.downloadStorage: Free some storage before downloading this model.
android.downloadVerification: Model verification failed. Please retry the download.
android.responseTooLong: The local response was too long. Try a shorter request.
android.emptyResponse: The local model returned no text. Try again.
android.unsupportedLanguage: Parakeet supports 25 European languages. Choose a supported language or a cloud/provider workflow for this language.
android.speechUnavailable: Parakeet model is not available. Please download it first from Models.
android.retentionConfirm: Dictations outside this retention period will be deleted from this phone. “Don’t save” deletes all dictation history. Notes are kept separately.
android.cleanupRecovery: Text cleanup failed. Your original transcript is available in Home.
android.removeModelConfirm: Remove this model from the phone? You can download it again.
android.privateModeDescription: Keep audio on this phone. Turn off to choose cloud processing.
android.styleNeedsCleanup: Turn on text cleanup in Models & processing to apply your tone.
android.tonePreview_default: Can we meet tomorrow? I have a few ideas to share.
android.tonePreview_formal: Would you be available to meet tomorrow? I have several ideas to discuss.
android.tonePreview_casual: Are you free tomorrow? I have a few ideas to share.
android.tonePreview_very_casual: free tomorrow? got some ideas to share
android.tonePreview_excited: Let’s meet tomorrow! I have some exciting ideas to share.
android.realBubblePractice: Tap the message field, then tap or hold the floating OpenWhispr bubble. Release to finish; tap the bubble again to stop hands-free recording.
android.accountStats: Across your account · last synced total
android.deviceStats: On this phone · counted from this update
android.insightsSyncBody: Share word counts and recording duration with your account, without transcript text. Requires saved history. Cloud backup is a separate choice.
android.meetingCloudBody: Cloud transcribes your microphone audio live. This recording is saved on your phone for recovery. Speaker labels are not available.
android.meetingPrivateBody: Meeting transcription is not available on-device yet. Your audio stays private. To use Cloud, choose it explicitly in AI and processing.
android.meetingFinishingBody: Waiting for the last words before saving.
android.purchaseRestored: Purchase restored. Your account has access.
android.noActivePurchase: No active Google Play purchase was found. Your existing access is unchanged.
android.planUnavailable: Your plan could not be loaded. Connect to the internet and try again.
android.meetingLeaveBody: Stop and save the transcript, or cancel transcription and keep the audio in your note.
android.billingPaymentPending: Your earlier payment is still unresolved. Check its status in Google Play, then refresh access after payment completes. If it was cancelled, contact support before starting another purchase.
android.billingAccessPending: Your purchase is complete. We’re checking access with the server. Use Refresh access to retry.
android.billingAppStore: Manage this subscription in your Apple account on an Apple device.
android.billingWorkspace: Your workspace provides access. Contact its administrator to change the plan.
android.deleteSpaceFolderBody: Delete “{{name}}” and its {{count}} notes for everyone in this space?
android.moonshineEnglishOnly: These Moonshine models support English only. Choose Parakeet for supported European languages, or select a cloud/provider workflow.
android.noteLeaveBody: Finish to add the transcript to your note, or discard this recording.
android.noteFinishingBody: Stay on this note while the recording starts or finishes.
android.statsOffline: Offline · showing the last synced total
android.statsUnavailable: Account totals unavailable. Connect and retry.
android.statsPending: Some dictations are waiting to sync. Totals will update after sync.
android.statsPaused: Account sync is paused. These are your counts on this phone.
android.deviceCheckSummary: Memory, storage and a local speed test
android.deviceCheckBody: See what your phone reports, then try your selected speech and cleanup models with a short recording.
android.deviceHeatUnknown: Heat status is unavailable on this Android version.
android.deviceHot: Your phone is limiting performance because of heat. Let it cool before testing local models.
android.deviceMemoryPressure: Android reports low available memory. Close other apps and try again, or choose Cloud explicitly in your workflow.
android.deviceTestPressure: Memory pressure or heat affected this test. Let the phone recover before comparing models.
android.deviceInfoUnavailable: Device information is unavailable. A speed test can still show how this sample performs.
android.deviceEmulator: This is an emulator. Its timing cannot establish performance or memory requirements for a real phone.
android.deviceSlow: This sample took longer to process than to speak. Try Qwen 0.5B, compare a smaller speech model for your language, or choose Cloud in your workflow if local speed is unsuitable.
android.deviceReviewAccuracy: This sample completed faster than its recording length. Review the words below before keeping this model pair; longer recordings and other languages may behave differently.
android.deviceLowRam: Android classifies this as a low-RAM phone. Start with the smaller models and test a sample before relying on local processing.
android.deviceTestFirst: Run a short test before choosing. RAM and download size alone do not establish speech accuracy or response time.
android.deviceChoiceUnchanged: These suggestions do not change your models, processing mode or privacy settings.
android.benchmarkBody: Choose an audio recording of 30 seconds or less (up to 25 MB). We will use the speech and Qwen models selected in Models, with your current language, tone and cleanup prompt. Both models must already be downloaded.
android.benchmarkPrivacy: This test runs on this phone, even if your normal workflow uses Cloud. Audio and text are not uploaded or added to history or Insights. Test copies are removed afterward; results disappear when you leave. Your original recording is kept.
android.benchmarkTiming:
Recording: {{duration}} s
Speech: {{speech}} s
Cleanup: {{cleanup}} s
Total processing: {{total}} s
android.benchmarkTimingHint: Total includes audio preparation, model loading when needed and waiting for other local work. This is one sample, not a phone rating. Available memory is a system snapshot, not this model’s peak use.
android.benchmarkAccuracy: Compare both results with what you said. Speed is useful only if the words and meaning are right.
android.benchmarkDownloads: Download the selected speech and Qwen models in Models before running this test.
android.benchmarkLength: Choose a recording of 30 seconds or less, no larger than 25 MB.
android.meetingSaveFailedBody: Recording has stopped. Your captured text is still here. Try saving again before leaving.
android.importFormats: Choose a WAV, MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG/Opus or WEBM file. Recording stays off.
android.importPrivateRemoteCleanup: Audio is transcribed on this phone. Transcript text is sent to your selected cleanup provider. The note is saved privately; imports from a shared space go to Personal.
android.importPrivateLocal: Private import: processed on this phone and saved as a private note. A shared-space import is saved in Personal.
android.importLocal: Audio is transcribed on this phone. Cleanup follows your AI workflow settings. The note follows your sync settings.
android.importByok: Audio is sent to your selected provider. The note follows your sync settings.
android.importCloud: Audio is sent to OpenWhispr Cloud. The note follows your sync settings.
android.importCancelBody: This import will stop without creating a note.
android.importInvalidDestination: This destination is invalid. Return to Notes.
android.importFolderUnavailable: This folder is no longer available. Return to Notes and choose a destination.
android.importSpaceUnavailable: This space is no longer available. Return to Notes and choose a destination.
android.importAccountChanged: Your account changed. Return to Notes and start a new import.
android.importDestinationChanged: The destination changed. Return to Notes and choose a destination.

library.contextHint: For tricky pronunciations, try a context phrase like
library.snippetsDescription: Turn a short spoken trigger into longer text. Say “signoff” and it expands to your full sign-off.
library.snippetDescription: A spoken trigger expands to its replacement text in your dictation.
library.duplicateTrigger: A snippet with that trigger already exists.
library.discardBody: Your snippet changes have not been saved.
library.deleteNoteBody: This note will be deleted permanently.
library.syncUpgrade: Cloud sync requires Pro — tap to upgrade
library.firstNote: Create your first note to start writing

editor.recordingNotes: You can edit these notes once the recording stops.
editor.processingUnfinished: Audio processing did not finish for this note.
editor.audioUnavailable: The original audio is no longer available, so this transcript cannot be retried.
editor.cloudRemovalBody: The note stays private on this device. Its cloud copy could not be removed yet; OpenWhispr will retry when sync is available.
